findings.title: Potential NullPointerException and missing credential ID in BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage.getCredentials
findings.body: In `getCredentials(RealmModel realm, UserModel user)`, `myUser` (returned by `getMyUser(user)`) is dereferenced at `if (myUser.recoveryCodes != null)` without a null check. `UserCredentialManager.getFederatedCredentialsStream()` queries all enabled `CredentialInputUpdater` providers in the realm, including for local users or users from other providers that are not in `BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage.users`. Unlike `getDisableableCredentialTypesStream`, `isConfiguredFor`, and `isValid` in the same class, `getCredentials` does not guard against `myUser == null`, resulting in a `NullPointerException` whenever federated credentials are listed for a non-storage user. Additionally, `RecoveryAuthnCodesCredentialModel.createFromValues(...)` on line 237 does not copy the ID set on `myUser.recoveryCodes` in `updateCredential` (line 195), leaving `model.getId()` as `null`.

findings.title: Exhausted user-storage recovery codes are not removed via removeStoredCredentialById and can fail on null ID
findings.body: With `RecoveryAuthnCodesUtils.getCredential(authenticatedUser)` now returning credentials from `getFederatedCredentialsStream()`, `optUserCredentialFound` may come from a `UserStorageProvider` rather than local storage. When `recoveryCodeCredentialModel.allCodesUsed()` is true, calling `authenticatedUser.credentialManager().removeStoredCredentialById(recoveryCodeCredentialModel.getId())` only searches local/federated DB credential stores and does not remove or disable the credential in the `UserStorageProvider` (which uses `disableCredentialType`). Moreover, if the `CredentialModel` constructed by the `UserStorageProvider` has a `null` ID (for example, when created via `RecoveryAuthnCodesCredentialModel.createFromValues` as in `BackwardsCompatibilityUserStorage.getCredentials`), passing `null` to `removeStoredCredentialById` causes JPA `EntityManager.find` to throw an `IllegalArgumentException`.
